<<A Word About Repointing A Chimney Stack>>

Repointing a chimney stack is essential for maintaining safety and efficiency. It involves replacing damaged or deteriorated mortar between bricks to prevent cracks and leaks. A hinge in the stack's structure ensures it remains stable, while a rivet may be used to secure the new mortar in place. Regular repointing extends the life of the chimney and ensures proper airflow. Always follow local building codes and consult a professional for safe, effective work.
